prompt:
Use case: precise-object-edit / style-transfer.
Asset type: a targeted final revision of this same 74x100 logical-pixel dialogue portrait.
Input roles: Image 1 is the portrait_v1 EDIT TARGET. Image 2 is the original identity reference. Images 3 through 6 are approved Mara, Ivo, Leiya and Tor STYLE references. Keep the target man's identity, apparent age, face orientation, sober expression, nose/jaw/cheek proportions, dominant costume palette and tight facial framing. Use identity reference only to correct identity; do not adopt its cartoon eyes or full-body shape. Do not change the person or introduce any new costume or story detail.
ONLY fix the target's excessively fragmented hair/stubble rendering. Keep this man around fifty, lean long/angular face, receding grey hairline, grey strong brows, sharp narrow controlled eyes, thin firmly closed flat mouth, bone-ivory upright collar and charcoal apparatus-protection edge. Rebuild the grey hair as only FOUR to SIX broad solid swept-back masses separated by a few purposeful dark stepped boundaries. Eliminate the tiny curls, web of crosshatching and pebble fragments completely. Replace the salt-and-pepper speckled beard texture with only TWO or THREE low-contrast grey-brown stubble shadow planes along upper lip and jaw; no full beard, no separate grey dots or hatch marks. Keep adult age structure with one purposeful brow crease and eye-bag plane, NOT a smoothed young face. Nose-side, nose-wing and cheekbone become fewer larger opaque hard shapes. Retain the subtle scar immediately behind his visible left ear, not on cheek. Expression remains guarded, impatient control, never sadness, grin, rage or sinister cartoon. A little forehead wear is useful; hundreds of wrinkles are not.
Rendering remains true coarse hard-cluster pixel art for 74x100 logical pixels, matched to the four approved style anchors. It must look like nearest-neighbor enlargement of that coarse grid even if the returned raster is large. Do not repaint in a high-resolution soft illustration. No micro-texture, dithering, antialiasing, grain, soft gradients, fuzzy edges, high-frequency highlights or scratchy hatching. At most 32 purposeful visible working colors in this batch. Small eyes with subdued whites, clear nostril wings and cheek planes, hard outer silhouette. Nearly entire frame filled by head; crown inside top, tiny collar only at bottom. Preserve genuine transparent alpha outside silhouette. Single character, no props/hands/chest/shoulders, no text, frame or background.
